tutorial.title: How to install indicators in NinjaTrader 8
tutorial.intro: Before we continue with the files for your purchase, let's review the general install process. Every indicator follows these same steps.

substeps.title: Download the files to your computer
substeps.description: Save each file in a folder you can remember — your Desktop is fine. You will need them in the next step.

substeps.title: Install the indicators in NinjaTrader 8
substeps.description: Open NinjaTrader 8, then follow the two steps shown in the screenshots below to import the files you just downloaded. Each image shows one step of the process — first the import action, then the confirmation dialog.

substeps.title: Wait for the confirmation, then restart NinjaTrader 8
substeps.description: When the import process finishes, NinjaTrader 8 will show a confirmation message. Once you see it, close NinjaTrader 8 completely and reopen it. This step is critical — without a restart, the indicators will not load and they will not appear on your charts.

closingNote.core+engine: Got it. **Important:** complete each step in order. Do NOT skip ahead — Core and Engine must be installed BEFORE the products, otherwise the indicators will not work. From the next step onwards, just download each file and apply the same process.

closingNote.none: Got it. From the next step onwards, download the file and apply the same process in NinjaTrader 8 shown above. If NinjaTrader 8 shows any prompts during the install, follow the on-screen instructions.

products.title: Download your products
products.description: Click each button below to download the file you need. Then follow the same install steps in NinjaTrader 8 shown in the previous tutorial — one at a time, because NinjaTrader 8 only lets you import one file at a time.

success.title: Restart NinjaTrader 8
success.description: Close and reopen NinjaTrader 8 so all the new files load. After the restart, your indicators are ready to use — you can apply them to any chart.
success.actionNote: This is the last step. When you restart, everything is configured.
